text:
GENERATE BURST L-forest_valley-0_0 — parallax background panel, the FIRST panel of its layer (Matt R-C3-42/48). task_id "L-forest_valley-0_0".

This image is one panel (upper-left) of a 3×2 grid of 1536×1024 panels (neighbours overlap by 256 px) that together form ONE continuous painted parallax background layer for a hand-painted 2D game scene seen past a cliff edge at sunset. The whole layer is the CHARRED FOREST VALLEY layer — nearer than the ruins: a vast burnt forest filling a valley: black skeletal trunks and branches, grey ash ground, pockets of glowing orange embers and small lingering fires, smoke curling up, a winding river reflecting the sunset. Its top silhouette (the far ridge line of burnt treetops) sits at about 25–32 % of the full layer's height; EVERYTHING ABOVE that silhouette is flat pure #00ff00; below it the forest fills everything down to the bottom edge, denser and darker toward the bottom.
Deliver ONE LANDSCAPE 1536×1024 image of this panel.
REGISTER: the level's approved painted style (IMAGE 2): hand-drawn painted 2D, tapered dark contours (lighter and thinner with distance), painted planes, bold Hades-like jewel tones and graphic shapes, rich detail. No characters, creatures, text, UI, border or vignette.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if a painted strip was altered, a join remains, the layer contains a cliff rim/characters/text, or (keyed layers) the area above the silhouette is not flat pure #00ff00 — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/L-forest_valley-0_0.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "L-forest_valley-0_0"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 2 — the approved painted STYLE and story of this background (do not copy its layout)
